answer: An adversary running 125 aliases therefore needs 114 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in ember, expire in vault, and ocean lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 545 identities would post 2477 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
